priority: other Radar leagues with sufficient verified coverage
season_label_policy: Do not infer labels until verified from source metadata or downloaded files.

source_candidates.name: Football-Data.co.uk Sweden
source_candidates.declared_coverage: historical full-time results and closing match odds for worldwide premier divisions, including Sweden
quality_notes: Use outcome columns only after pre-match feature freeze.
Do not treat generic best/average/Pinnacle closing odds as GoldBet.
Opening-to-closing analysis is allowed only for bookmaker/timestamp pairs explicitly present and verifiable in the downloaded schema.
Pinnacle data after 2025-07-23 requires caution due to provider reliability warning; keep that period separately flagged.

market_close_benchmark.rule: Benchmark market closing prices may support CLV/context only under their true bookmaker/source labels; they never substitute GoldBet TRUE OPEN.

intermediate_t30.rule: Never derive T-30 from CLOSE or interpolate absent timestamps.

pre_match_structural.anti_leakage: Each rolling feature must use only prior fixtures in chronological order.

quarantine_rules: prospective 2026 snapshots are not multi-season historical evidence
FIRST_SEEN cannot substitute TRUE OPEN in primary MMS tests
non-GoldBet bookmaker odds cannot be relabelled GoldBet
single-fixture proofs cannot support threshold promotion
sources without unambiguous fixture identity or timestamps are excluded
post-kickoff facts are outcome/evaluation data only

acceptance_gate.baseline_fixture_model: verified fixture identity + kickoff/date order + authoritative outcome; all rolling features shifted strictly to prior matches
acceptance_gate.market_benchmark: bookmaker/source identity and price semantics verified from schema/provider notes
acceptance_gate.primary_mms: GoldBet same bookmaker + same event + market + period + line + selection + real TRUE OPEN and later observed timestamp
acceptance_gate.reason: Sweden external baseline source is being profiled; GoldBet historical TRUE OPEN remains unavailable.

next_source_block.goal: Validate discovered CSV schemas, verify four season labels from source, ingest fixture/result baseline, then freeze chronological development/holdout. Keep GoldBet MMS as a separate unavailable lane until a real source exists.
